Arirang Garden

A 90-second instrumental arrangement of the traditional Korean folk melody Arirang, prepared for this game. New accompaniment, phrasing, synthesized plucked-string lead, and circular room mix. No existing recording of an Arirang performance was used.

Traditional melody

Arirang is a traditional folk song with many regional variations. This arrangement uses its familiar traditional melody rather than a contemporary artist's performance or backing track. Background: UNESCO — Arirang. Melody reference: Arirang notation.
